source_integrity_notes: The supplied PDF prints PMID as “xxxx”; no external PMID was substituted.
Table 1 prints the between-attacks interval for Patient 12 as “6” without a unit in that cell; the SEA preserves this unresolved source text.
Several paired comparisons are reported only as P > 0.05 without exact p-values or confidence intervals; no equivalence claim was inferred.
Treatment patterns differ substantially between attacks, so the study cannot establish that episode severity is equivalent or that treatment caused the observed disability pattern.
Two patients were excluded for “comorbidities” without further explanation in the article.
All model-extracted atoms remain needs_review because no independent human reviewer identity is represented.
